notes.title: v 1.1.7 - Update
notes.content:
Hello there! 

I hope you are all doing well. 

As always, I do listen to feedback and read reviews, so thank you everyone. And with that said, you now have the following changes in update 1.1.7;

- Movement speed increased / Improved terrain navigation.
- New checkpoints.
- AI spawn tweaked.
- Ammo dump location moved.
- Tutorial text edited. 
- Tutorial enemies speed adjusted. 

[b]Checkpoints[/b]
The new checkpoints, along with the previous difficulty option released in update 1.1.6 should give you a more comfortable experience. 

Upon loading from a checkpoint, you will receive a default ammo amount. This was done to prevent you running to a checkpoint with no ammo left... then being stuck in an unwinnable situation each time you re-spawn. 

The checkpoint location will vary on the route you take. For example, you go directly to the village, that will give you a checkpoint. If you instead decide to go and do secondary objectives, and let's say checkpoint at the 2nd, secondary objective, because the village is nearby, you will then not get a checkpoint at the village. This was done with the aim of keeping the game challenging, but fair and enjoyable.

[i]Everything is tested prior to public release, however there has been quite a few scripts added and edited with this update, so If you do encounter any problems, please do let me know.

Have a nice day![/i]

tags.balance_change: - Movement speed increased / Improved terrain navigation.

tags.feature: - New checkpoints.

notes.title: v 1.1.6 - Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello there! [/b]

[b]Update 1.1.6 is here.[/b]

After much thought on the best way to implement this and after seeing many comments, you now have a difficulty option. 

You can choose between survivor and survivalist difficulty.

I wanted to keep the game at it's core, the same. So having noticed 2 main complaints were bullet sponge enemies and the lack of ammo. The new difficulty option "survivor", reduces the shots required to kill enemies. Fixing these 2 complaints at the same time and giving you an easier option. 

To be clear, there is enough ammo playing on the survivalist difficulty. You just have to conserve and aim. So, i still recommend you give that a go first. 

[b]Other changes - [/b]
- Training map enemies HP reduced. 
- Training map text timings adjusted. 

There has also been some minor UI adjustments and background scripts tweaked to prevent possible performance issues. 

[i]If you do encounter any problems, please do let me know.

Have a nice day![/i]

notes.title: v 1.1.2 - Update
notes.content:
Hello there,

If you was waiting to give this game a go or you tried it before and was waiting for the game to become "better", this may be the time to actually play it.

Update 1.1.2 is focused on improving, polishing and fixing the game. I have been watching videos, reading posts, reading reviews and have done my best with this update to address the remaining problems. So this update has the following changes;

- All sound is now prioritised and the volume adjusts itself on a per sound basis, depending on the importance. So you will now be able to hear enemy movement over the music for example, while still taking into account your volume settings.

- The "black screen" which shows after the loading screen has been improved. On my testing rig, this has gone from 10 seconds to 1.5 seconds with this new update, with actual reloading after death, being even quicker. This will vary based on your hardware, but overall you should no longer have any problems.

- All sounds and music now fade out correctly and fully on level loading and the distortion which sometimes happened has been fixed.

- On launching the training mode, you will now be greeted with story narration. Which was really needed, with the option to "skip", if your not interested.

- You will now find your characters information on the main menu.

- Game ending - story text - added - based on the objectives you complete.
 
- UI updated, all menu's are now done via the mouse, removing the need to press "Y" or "N" on the keyboard. 

- UI resolution scaling fixed for the training map.

- Powerup location added.

- Multiple music/sound events added for improved background ambience/effect.

- Game over screen has been updated. (Blood Effect)

- Removed unused code / optimizing.

- Thread optimization, additional music/events moved to background thread.

- Ammo collision bug - fixed.

- AI code conflict - fixed. (On the rare chance you would die/kill the enemy at the exact same time)

- Music/Effect sounds have been moved from Sound to Music for the options volume slider.

- Enemy spawn adjustment to fix collision, along with delay, which now prevents all enemies running in sync. 

- Mission triggers sometimes blocking bullets - fixed.

- Starting ammo - changed from 15 to 19 (Full clip). 

- Ammo dumps - changed from 25 to 30 rounds.

- AI navigation - fixed.  (No longer walk across water)

- Enemy spawns added. (more enemies, YAY)

- Secondary objective data not resetting - Fixed.


I think that covers most things, but you may notice other minor adjustments. 

If you do encounter any problems, please do let me know.

Thank you for your time. Have a nice day!

notes.title: v 1.1.0 - Update
notes.content:
Hello there!

Here it is, the 10th update bringing us to version 1.1.0 and hopefully a much better gaming experience for you all.

- [b]Surface based sound effects implemented[/b], so whether Grass/Stone/Gravel/Sand or a mixture of them all, you will now have accurate traversal sounds which are synced to your characters feet for movement, jumping and impacting the ground from heights.

- [b]New "Adrenaline Rush" collectable powerup added[/b] to help with extensive map traversal.

- [b]Bullet sound/impact effect will now change based on what you are shooting[/b] [i](Example, shoot a rock, it will spark and change pitch)[/i]

-[b] Various environmental decals added[/b] [i](Example, while moving through sand you will now kick up sand/dust under your feet and leave footprints behind)[/i]

-[b] Enemy impact effects improved[/b], so you can now clearly see when you are hitting your target.

- [b]Enemy height navigation updated[/b] to fix terrain clipping bug.

- [b]Tutorial updated.[/b]

- [b]Asset Pre-loading updated[/b] to give you a smoother experience.

This covers most of the important changes, but there has been some other minor tweaks to improve the game. As previously mentioned, the game does default to low graphical settings, so to see the game at its best you will need to change these yourself.

I hope you are all doing well and thank you for reading about the newest update. 

Any problems, please let me know.

notes.title: v 1.0.1 - Update
notes.content:
Hello there, so i have been testing, listening to feedback and here is what i have for you all so far. - [b]Update 1.0.1[/b]

- 3D sound now implemented for all enemies within a set proximity to you, this is to give you actual directional warning when they are getting close.

- The proximity range of faster enemies has been increased by 75%, so you will hear the directional screaming and will now have more time to react.

- Enemy proximity scream not always working while on hills - Fixed

- Rank not displaying on main menu after ranking up - Fixed

- AI occasionally stopping/running on the spot - Fixed

- Sound effect upon water death - Added

- In-game prompt when you rank-up - Added.

- UI button sound changed.

- Game over screen updated.

[i]Is that it? ... Not at all, more improvements and content is being worked on and will be implemented when ready.[/i]

Please note - By default the game will set itself to the lowest quality, with no shadows, low textures.. etc, so you will need to adjust your settings to experience the game at its current best. These default to low, so those on minimum requirements do not lagg on initial boot up and can adjust according the their specs.
